in_sanskrit.name: Appala
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Appala
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Appala एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Appala is derived from the Tamil word 'Appalaru' which means 'goddess'. It is believed that the name Appala is associated with the goddess of the same name who is revered in the Hindu tradition. The name Appala is said to represent grace, beauty, and harmony.
